title: 安全系统误判逮捕
description: 在公共区域拆解合法打捞的组件时被保安逮捕，原因不明，安全系统判定不合理。
evidence: If you drag a component you have legitimately salvaged into the station and start dismantling it in the public space, security will rush over and arrest you.
